svg.aria-label: Gossip (epidemic broadcast): Tell a few random neighbours, a few times; the rumour does the rest.. round 1: the rumour to f random neighbours; first time: deliver it; round 2: they tell f others each; already heard: stay quiet. Reach grows fast in the number of rounds and cheaply in messages, but nothing is guaranteed.
